method_logic.research_program_level: Test one frozen candidate mechanism, classify the complete valid result, then decide whether a separately versioned next mechanism is warranted.
method_logic.within_batch_level: Cells may run one at a time, but the full schedule, inputs, thresholds, exclusions, retry and stopping rules, and analysis are frozen before the first model action.
method_logic.intermediate_outcomes: Scientific outcomes remain sealed and may not change later cells.
method_logic.technical_failure: Abort and burn the current authorization; any retry requires a fresh pre-frozen signed authorization.
method_logic.decision_point: Open and classify results once, only after the complete batch and all technical gates pass.
method_logic.meaning_of_solve: A passing R13 batch would retain a narrow target-interface mechanism in four fixed development stacks; it would not prove that a shared result caused cross-task transfer.

evidence_partition.existing_evidence: The frozen R10 model-free diagnostic rejected the old uniform shared-latent-result-identity mechanism on all four M0 stacks.
evidence_partition.reasonable_inference: The exact M0/M1 split makes target codebook or verifier-surface alignment a plausible controlled development hypothesis.
evidence_partition.unverified_core_hypothesis: One fixed source-only update changes target wrong-vs-gold log-odds differently under the two frozen target codebook interfaces.
evidence_partition.not_observed: No R13 tokenizer load, model load, forward pass, gradient, optimizer step, raw model result, or scientific result exists.

frozen_scientific_design.directional_guard: A positive relative interface effect with A_aligned<=0 is RELATIVE_PRESERVATION_ONLY_NOT_ABSOLUTE_AMPLIFICATION; 0<A_aligned<=1e-10 is a dead zone.
frozen_scientific_design.scope: Four frozen outcome-aware M0 affine development stacks in two task-pair clusters.

lazy_backend_adapter.verified_shape: Source-only 14-row projection, five updates, same post-update hash for two target arms, twelve read-only target reads per process, and A/B source-spec invariance.
